The meeting with the supplier was useful. We asked about the delivery time for the new order. They said the normal time is three weeks, but if we confirm before Friday, they can send the first batch in ten days. The price is the same as last year, which is good. We need to check the quality of the sample before we agree. I will send the sample to the warehouse team tomorrow. If they approve it, we can place the order on Friday. The supplier also asked whether we need the same packaging as the previous order. I said yes, unless the warehouse team prefers a smaller box.
